_note: REAL values from data/build_evidence.py. Nulls are explained by 'reason'. Not signed, not sent. Target: NOFI Avalanche L1 testnet chainId 880024.

fieldPixel.basis: nearest HLS 30 m pixel with NDVI>=0.5 on a recent clear scene (data/out/green_pixel_candidates.json); the app point is bare ground. Confirm with the farmer.

et_mm.stat: mean ETdaily of 1 valid overpasses x 30 days

precip_mm.reason: GES DISC returned 403 'EULA Acceptance Failure' for this Earthdata token

ndvi.stat: monthly median of 14 clear 30 m scenes (Fmask)

engine.waterSavedBasis: (alfalfa Kc 0.95 - rotation Kc 0) x ET0 135.1 mm / 0.60 x 1.2 ha; Kc calendar is an assumption; ET0 from the POWER cell shared with Carumas (3851 m; within 5 % of ERA5 ET0); NDVI 0.04 < 0.20 -> contract anti-abandonment rule would block a credit
engine.recommendationBasis: dashboard + SI fixture recommendation; water saving recomputed below with ET0 x FAO-56 Kc

extensions._label: Extension block: not part of the required oracle schema. Partner/NON-NASA layers labelled per field.

soil.label: NON-NASA (ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, 250 m, machine-learning model; uncertain in hyper-arid/irrigated valleys)

cover.dataset: ESA Sentinel-2 L2A 10 m (partner; Element84 Earth Search STAC, SCL cloud mask)
cover.method: Monthly median of SCL-masked S2 L2A NDVI (classes 4/5/6 kept; 0-3, 7-11 dropped) 2024-01..2026-11; HLS fills months with no S2. Bare = median NDVI < 0.20. Vulnerable = month meeting >=2 of: bare, rainy (ERA5 1991-2020 >=10% of annual), frost (>=5 d Tmin<2C, preferred series per farm).

frost.preferred_reason: shares the Carumas POWER cell (~2,275 m above the farm); a 14.8 C lapse shift is too large to trust, so ERA5-Land (0.1 deg) is used

slope.method: Horn (1981) 3x3 finite difference on SRTM GL1 30 m sampled on a 5x5 grid (30 m spacing) via OpenTopoData; centre = field point, window = 9 cells over 90x90 m

erosion.method: Erosion-risk proxy (relative, unitless, NOT soil loss): tan(mean slope over 90x90 m SRTM window) x (a) mean annual count of days >10 mm, (b) mean intensity on days above the wet-day (>=1 mm) 95th percentile. IMERG was the requested rain source but GES DISC returns 403 EULA Acceptance Failure for this Earthdata account; POWER and ERA5-Land daily used as substitutes and both reported.
erosion.imerg_status: blocked: Earthdata account must accept the GES DISC EULA (urs.earthdata.nasa.gov > Applications > Authorized Apps / EULAs)

extensions.fieldPixelStatus: PENDING/PARTIAL: field-pixel HLS+ECOSTRESS re-sampling still running; indicators.ndvi / et_mm here are from the bare app point and understate the crop. extensions.cover (Sentinel-2) already uses the field pixel.
